summary: All round-1 substantive findings are resolved. (1) TriggerTest.equalsAndHashCodeIgnoreCanvasPosition constructs two triggers differing only in canvasPosition with distinct concrete values (10.0/20.0 vs 999.0/-999.0) and asserts isEqualTo + hasSameHashCodeAs — value-based, catches real regressions. A third case (null vs present) covers the total-exclusion invariant. (2) FunnelControllerIT.notes_round_trip_with_server_minted_id now asserts $.steps[0].stepType = MESSAGE on both the PUT response and the subsequent GET, satisfying the sibling-field-unchanged requirement. (3) FunnelServiceNotesTest.notes_echoedIdMustMatchObjectIdHexShape calls assert422 with a non-hex and a wrong-length/uppercase id, verifying HTTP 422 + CODE_NOTE_INVALID — concrete error code and status. (4) FunnelServiceNotesTest.notes_duplicateIdWithinFunnelRejected echoes a valid ObjectId hex twice and verifies 422 + CODE_NOTE_INVALID — correctly isolates the seenIds guard from the shape check. No remaining gaps: litmus test passes for all new tests (removing the guard code would make each fail), assertions are value-based throughout, and no count-only or presence-only checks were introduced.
